Identified as this saint because: A photograph Commons titles «Проф. др Јустин Поповић» and files under its category 'Justin (Popović)', released by the Orthodox Theological Faculty of the University of Belgrade — where he was professor — under a permission Commons records on the file page, and dated by Commons between 1934 and 1945, his years in that chair. This folder is that man: doxologia.ro prints «Sfântul Iustin Popovici» and saint.gr «Άγιος Ιουστίνος Πόποβιτς», born Blagoje Popović at Vranje in 1894 and reposed in 1979. The Vavedenje fresco was the other candidate and was dropped rather than refused: it paints him beside Nikolaj Velimirović, two saints in one picture. Commons describes it: Проф. др Јустин Поповић
